title: IdeaSeek EvidenceAudit (evidence-audit-v1)
description: Structural contract for the deterministic claim/citation audit, mirroring the writer: `ideaseek idea claim-audit` computes and persists this artifact to ideas/<ideaId>/evidence-audit.json (src/idea/claim-audit.ts runClaimAudit + writeClaimAudit) with no model in the loop, so the schema accepts exactly what that literal emits. Checked structurally: the tag, the card binding (ideaId + cardVersion), the overall verdict word, each check entry (which of the three evidence kinds it is, its verdict, and page as number|null) and the stats triple. What stays in TypeScript: whether a quote is actually locatable in the indexed paper (locateQuote + NFKC), whether a paperRef resolves to an indexed artifact at all, registry membership of a nearestComparison, and the verdict rule itself (missing>0 -> fail, else unverified>0 -> warn) — recomputing verdict from checks is the domain module's job, not the schema's. `cardHash` is declared optional in the EvidenceAudit interface even though today's only writer always fills it, so it stays out of required. `checks` may be EMPTY: a card with no paperEvidence and no nearestComparisons and no full-run report is a valid, passing audit.
